A [[Gender/Legends|female]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was anointed the first '''Queen of Naboo''' more than three millennia before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. She was one of the Human colonists who had fled a civil war on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] and established a new civilization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], a green haven located on the borders of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="SON" />

While her people was engaged in bloody conflict with the native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], that woman was chosen to lead the colonists, who took the name of their new [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and became known as "the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]]." Although she accepted both the title and the function of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], that woman refused to be the founder of a hereditary succession line. Instead, the newly elected Queen decreed that her successor would be selected based on their merits only. This started a tradition of meritocratic democracy on Naboo, which would still be used millennia later.<ref name="SON" /> However, the constitution of Naboo had a provision that allowed the monarchy to become hereditary for a worthy dynasty, and this happened at least once in history.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
